items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 64:1
items.html: (To the question) Every aspect of the vessels that already served at the time of Nekudim, except that after their shattering they returned and received their correction by the lights of Atzilut, which are called MAH — all these are discerned by the name BAN, whose source is SAG. For the ten Sefirot of Nekudim are the aspects of the points of SAG; but because they became needing to receive correction from MAH, they are discerned as a Nukva toward the MAH, and therefore they are now called BAN, for the Nukva of MAH is called by the name BAN. Hence, in the smallness of the Partzuf, as long as it has no Mochin, there is no correction of the aspects of the lights at all there, but only the completion of the vessels of BAN that are clarified from BYA; and even the Mochin of VAK are only the completion of vessels. It is thus found that there is no aspect of MAH itself there, namely the stature of the Mochin attributed to Atzilut. And the aspect of MAH begins only in the Gadlut, namely in the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin of face to face, which are the aspect of the GAR of the lights called MAH, which correct the Mochin of BAN, after they clothe in the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin of the externality of the Partzuf, called BAN, as above. It is thus found that there is no MAH there except in the Gadlut, namely after the VAK and the Mochin of VAK are completed, they become fit to receive the lights of MAH. (Item 64).
